SELECT QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, STATUS, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, DATA01 AS ORIGIN_NAME, MAKER_NAME, UNIT_MEASURE, UNIT_PRICE, DATA03 AS REMARK, PLANT, DATA02 AS IMAGE_URL, CATEGORY_PATH, (SELECT MAX(REF_NO) FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER = A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE AND QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ ) AS RFX_NO FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND A WHERE BELOW_COMORG_CODE IN ('KRSKPU0001','KRSKPU0002') AND TRIM(CATEGORY4) IS NULL AND QUOTATION_NO = #QUOTATION_NO# AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND SET IF_FLAG = #flag#, IF_DATE = SYSDATE, IF_MSG = #msg# WHERE BELOW_COMORG_CODE IN ('KRSKPU0001','KRSKPU0002') AND BELOW_COMORG_CODE = 'KRSKPU0001' AND QUOTATION_NO = #QUOTATION_NO# AND QUOTATION_NO = #QUOTATION_SEQ# AND TRIM(CATEGORY4) IS NULL AND IF_FLAG = 'N'

UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'E', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE BELOW_COMORG_CODE IN ('KRSKPU0001','KRSKPU0002') AND BELOW_COMORG_CODE = 'KRSKPU0001' AND TRIM(CATEGORY4) IS NULL AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
sqlMap.select: SELECT PODT.PO_NO, PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO, PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, MAX(PORS.BUYER_DS_DATE) AS BUYER_DS_DATE, MAX(PODT.ITEM_QTY) AS CD_QTY, PODT.PLANT FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMTRXL TRXL, ICOMPORS PORS WHERE TRXL.DOC_NAME = 'DSDOWN' AND TRIM(TRXL.KEY_9) IS NULL AND PODT.BUYER IN ('KRSKPU0001','KRSKPU0002') AND PODT.BUYER = PORS.BUYER AND PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = PORS.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND PODT.PO_NO = PORS.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = PORS.PO_SEQ AND SUBSTR(NVL(TRIM(PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO), ' '),1,2) NOT IN (' ','PM') AND PODT.BUYER = TRXL.TARGET AND PODT.PO_NO = TRXL.KEY_1 GROUP BY PODT.PO_NO,PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, PODT.PLANT
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = #flag#, KEY_8 = #msg#, KEY_2 = #LEGACY_PO_NO#, KEY_3 = #LEGACY_PO_SEQ#, KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP,'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'DSDOWN' AND TARGET = 'KRSKPU0001' AND KEY_1 = #PO_NO# AND TRIM(KEY_2) IS NULL AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL
